description: Erection of a roof extension with front and rear windows and a raised front, side and rear parapet wall to form an additional floor to be used as an office space.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: S01, S02-A, S03-A, S04-A, C01, C02, C03-A, C04-A, C05, C06, C07-A, C08, C09, C10, Design & Access Statement, Heritage Statement and Significance Assessment Report received 10 August 2023.

Condition : 3 - Notwithstanding any information given in the documents hereby approved, the materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match the materials used the neighbouring property No 6 Church Street
